items.company: Deloitte Tax Services India Pvt. Ltd. (Deloitte USI)
items.title: Summer Intern – Tax Compliance, US Business Tax Services
items.summary: US federal business tax compliance for corporate and partnership clients, in the Financial Services Group.
bullets: Selected from the entire USI Tax intern cohort across India to address Global Tax Leadership.
One of two interns in the batch selected for the Financial Services Group: structured finance and securitization vehicles (CLOs, CDOs, ABS).
Supported US federal business tax compliance for corporate and partnership clients (Forms 1120 / 1065), including S-corp and C-corp.
Allocated five client engagements; maintained engagement trackers and tax workpaper templates.
Internship research: “The Role of Technology in Transforming U.S. Tax Compliance Operations at Deloitte USI Tax.”

items.title: Financial Data Analyst & Research Intern – Corporate Actions
items.summary: Corporate-actions research for EventVestor, a data platform serving quantitative hedge funds and asset managers.
items.outcome: Converted to a Summer Internship offer
bullets: Researched and validated earnings calls and corporate actions across Indian and South Korean equities for EventVestor, a data platform serving quantitative hedge funds and asset managers.
Analysed BSE/NSE disclosures under SEBI (LODR) Regulations 29 & 30; applied comparable frameworks to South Korean issuers.
Extracted point-in-time data from unstructured filings, ran historical data audits and classified M&A and financing events.
Did all of this alongside full-time PGDM classes.
items.note: Declined the Summer Internship offer to pursue structured finance at Deloitte USI.
